name: Block Clash
tagline: Build clean. Send trouble. Stay standing.
description: Everyone gets the same shuffled blocks on their own board. Rotate and drop blocks to clear full rows, then send garbage to a rival. Survive for two minutes or be the last player standing.
howToPlay: Move and rotate your block. Drop it to fill a row with no gaps.
Clear rows to cancel incoming garbage, then send the rest to your chosen rival.
Keep below the top. Last standing wins; at two minutes, survivors rank first.
